head_outputs.format: YOLOv8-pose head, three scales (stride 32/16/8), decoded on the host
head_outputs.decode: Hailo Model Zoo v2.18 _yolov8_decoding: box = cell centre -/+ stride * E[softmax(DFL)]; keypoint = stride * (2 * raw + cell index); visibility = sigmoid(raw)
head_outputs.keypoints: COCO-17: nose, eyes, ears, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles

preprocessing.capture_format: Picamera2 RGB888 byte order converted from BGR to RGB

hailo.published_accuracy: COCO keypoints mAP 59.2 float / 55.7 on Hailo-8; 393 FPS at batch 1

notes: Downloaded 2026-10-02 from the Hailo Model Zoo v2.18.0 public bucket (10592016 bytes); hailortcli parse-hef on the station: HAILO8, single context, input 640x640x3 UINT8, nine head outputs.
Weights are Ultralytics YOLOv8s-pose (AGPL-3.0), like the YOLOv8n HEF it sits beside.
Profile hailo_yolov8s_pose aims at the head (anchor_target: head): measured head keypoints, else above the shoulders, else a box fraction; the anchor source is published per detection.
